Container.Name: flaresolverr-next
Container.Overview:
flaresolverr-next is a FlareSolverr build for Quasarr. It passes site security checks in a real browser and adds executeJs results, trusted clicks and a Google reCAPTCHA solver.
Use it as a drop-in replacement for FlareSolverr: point Quasarr at http://[IP]:8191/v1.
Optional: when a site shows an interactive reCAPTCHA, flaresolverr-next can hand the token solve to 2Captcha. Sign up at https://2captcha.com/?from=27506687 and enter your API key below. Without a key, it only tries the reCAPTCHA checkbox.

Config.Name: API Port
Config.Description: FlareSolverr API port. Quasarr uses http://[IP]:8191/v1.

Config.Name: Config folder
Config.Description: Persistent storage, for example for a log file set in Log File.

Config.Name: 2Captcha API Key
Config.Description: Optional. Lets flaresolverr-next hand interactive Google reCAPTCHA challenges to 2Captcha. https://2captcha.com/?from=27506687

Config.Name: Log File
Config.Description: Optional path for a log file, for example /config/flaresolverr.log. none logs to the console only.

Config.Name: Browser Wait Timeout
Config.Description: Seconds to wait for the browser to reach an expected page state on each attempt. Increase on slow hosts.

Config.Name: Proxy URL
Config.Description: Optional proxy for all browser traffic, for example http://192.168.1.1:8080.
